blocks.text:
A slowdown in aftermarket activity or aircraft production would first pressure segment sales and inventory conversion. If collections weakened while acquired businesses absorbed integration cash, operating cash generation would fall before the distant term and note maturities became the immediate constraint. The October distribution leaves less cash to absorb that operational shortfall; the first financing pressure would therefore be the receivables facility and revolver dependence, not an assumed imminent bond maturity. Observable warnings are renewed receivable and inventory absorption, cash paid catching up with accrued interest, failure to renew receivables financing, and rising revolver usage.
Basis: TDG_2024-09-30_10-K_0001260221-24-000083_tdg-20240930.htm.jsonl, pages 50, 56–57, 62, 71, 123 and 153; TDG_FY2024_annual-report_SEC-PDF_0001260221-25-000008_a841225transdigmgroupbookm.pdf, pages 47–48

The strongest challenge to that downside is the documented improvement in segment margins and actual operating cash generation, together with the extended financing maturities and reported covenant compliance. It would outweigh concern over the cash distribution if cash were subsequently retained and collections remained sound. Conversely, recurring debt-funded distributions or acquisitions would weaken the inference that operating improvement will accrue to creditors. No stress magnitude, default date or covenant headroom is established here.
Basis: TDG_2024-09-30_10-K_0001260221-24-000083_tdg-20240930.htm.jsonl, pages 50, 53–56, 62 and 123

No independent external corroboration or visual inspection is claimed.

High severity: controlling credit agreements, indentures, guarantee and collateral schedules and intercreditor terms are absent. The summary rank descriptions support a partial descriptive stack only; securitization, finance leases and government advances are excluded from relative-ranking subtotals because their relative priority is not established. Obtain the operative documents and obligor-level balances to establish enforceable priority, cash accessibility, covenant capacity and recoveries.
Basis: TDG_2024-09-30_10-K_0001260221-24-000083_tdg-20240930.htm.jsonl, pages 57, 61–62, 145–146 and 153; Source readiness (CP-0)

Medium severity: FFO, FFO interest cover, separate gross interest expense and separate interest income are not established. Cash interest paid net is usable for historical coverage but not a substitute for forward debt service. Obtain the gross interest schedule, hedge settlements and a defined FFO reconciliation before using those measures. The same restriction applies to both annual periods.
Basis: TDG_2024-09-30_10-K_0001260221-24-000083_tdg-20240930.htm.jsonl, pages 71, 121 and 123

Medium severity: maintenance and growth capex, unlevered cash-tax treatment, separately identified disposal cash proceeds and a comprehensive exceptional subtotal are not established for either year. Total-capex levered FCF remains usable; a maintenance-only cash yield, unlevered FCF or pure recurring earnings conclusion does not. Obtain the underlying expenditure, disposal and adjustment schedules. Stock compensation is disclosed both as stock-option equity expense and as a broader stock-and-deferred-compensation add-back; the broader amount must not be relabelled as pure stock compensation.
Basis: TDG_2024-09-30_10-K_0001260221-24-000083_tdg-20240930.htm.jsonl, pages 71 and 122–123

Medium severity: the calculated broad operating asset and liability cash movement and the management EBITDA-bridge reversal have different scopes, and their difference is not fully decomposed. Obtain the bridge detail before treating either as a clean measure of recurring working-capital absorption. Their distinct reported and calculated identities have been retained rather than forced to agree.
Basis: TDG_2024-09-30_10-K_0001260221-24-000083_tdg-20240930.htm.jsonl, pages 71 and 123; calculation C7

Low severity: several source dashes are retained as missing quantities rather than converted to zero. These include discontinued operations, some disposal and retirement-plan cash-flow adjustments, repurchases, revolver repayments, prior-year securitization proceeds and prior-year dividends payable. Restricted cash, short-term investments, a separate senior unsecured debt subtotal and pension liabilities are not separately established in this extraction.
